label: [ Principle 04 ]

blocks.text: Finally, I’d like/love to tell you about my relatives
I have many relatives because both of my parents have many brothers and sisters/siblings.
My father has 2 brothers and 2 sisters, while my mother has 3 brothers and 3 sisters.
My father is the oldest in his family, while my mother is the second child in her family.
Most my aunts and uncles are married.
I have a total of 6 cousins: 3 from my father’s side and 3 from my mother’s side of the family.
Even though my grandparents have passed away, I consider them a part of my family.
My paternal grandparents lived near by from my house.
Because my father was the oldest child in his family, my paternal grandparents lived with my family.
My grandfather would always give me good advice, and my grandmother would help my mother make delicious food.
My maternal grandparents didn’t live near my house, so I would visit them two times a year.
Whenever I visited them, I would help my grandfather in the garden/take a walk in the park with him, and I would help my grandmother prepare tasty food/snacks in the kitchen.
